description: React component for managing and displaying a permissions tree in the Mattermost admin console, including dynamic group updates based on license and config, and rendering permission groups with modals and buttons.

classes.name: PermissionsTree
classes.description: React component class for rendering and managing a permissions tree with dynamic group updates based on license and configuration.

methods.name: updateGroups
methods.description: Updates permission groups based on current config, license, scope, and role, adding or removing permissions accordingly.

methods.name: openPostTimeLimitModal
methods.description: Sets state to show the post time limit modal.

methods.name: closePostTimeLimitModal
methods.description: Sets state to hide the post time limit modal.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: React lifecycle method to update groups when config or license props change.

methods.name: toggleGroup
methods.description: Handles toggling of permission groups, invoking onToggle callback if not read-only.
